name: Millrace the Blue-Grey Cat
blurb: Millrace, a plush solid blue-grey cat with pale green eyes, sits by the garden stream all day, watching the water turn the little wooden wheel.

name: Windrow the Sandy Tabby Cat
blurb: Windrow, a sandy-gold tabby with soft caramel stripes and golden eyes, stretches out in the long meadow grass where the breeze blows steadiest.

name: Lodestone the Copper Tortie Cat
blurb: Lodestone, a tortoiseshell cat mottled in black and bright copper with gold eyes, digs through the rockery and lines up the shiniest pebbles.
